decisions: Two compiled TypeNamePolicy catalogs bind16 intrinsic declaration spellings to actual TypeId member names. CSharp caches exact ordinal dictionaries, rejects unknown/numeric enum keys, and BuildTypeDefinitions uses a nullable lookup before the original nextTypeId++ fallback.

Actual CSharp437 struct and550 enum IDs/names/module identities are unchanged against the pre-refactor registry; original ABI8 passes. Struct declarations remain before enum declarations and intrinsic slots never advance FirstUserDefined. Duplicate/reserved-name decisions remain unchanged.

Replace SLG intrinsicIdentity paired arrays with shared-catalog lookup by exact declaration spelling and kind. Map the returned enum member through the already generated enumValue. Keep declaration validation, struct/enum traversal, aliases and box ordering unchanged.

The shared text lookup adapter remains in type_name_policy to avoid a circular import. reference_type_ids consumes that adapter and enumValue within its existing namespace; no source manifest changes.

Current CSharp68 passes before authored SLG changes. Retain every compiled-policy query and add actual factory-return controls for valid names, wrong kinds, prefixes, case and unqualified near misses. No original1999 or Stage/profile replay.
